Title: Meridian Loan Origination: SERVICE_TASK kyc-aml-check inside PARALLEL_GATEWAY fork never dispatched; instance stalls ACTIVE (UAT WF05-FULL3-20261001 F1). Severity MAJOR. Symptom: meridian Loan Origination v1.1 on QA: after credit-memo-review (ben) and risk-assessment (miriam) complete, current_nodes=[kyc-aml-check]; instance ACTIVE >6.5min (past 300s timeout_ms) with no task, no SERVICE_TASK_COMPLETED event, no EXECUTION_ERROR, no DLQ row; endpoint answers 200 directly; top-level service tasks complete in 2-6s. Suspect SERVICE_TASK activation inside PARALLEL_GATEWAY fork branch (cf. ISS-0398 walk_to_gateway, resolved): likely no service_task_dispatches row armed on the fork/join walk path (Letflow.Engine fork activation / arm_service_task_dispatch call sites / TaskActivation). ALSO: kyc-routing has no unconditional edge and the stub endpoint returns no kyc_status, so the token may stall at kyc-routing even once dispatched -- assess whether fixture/process-definition issue (test/fixtures/qa/ meridian loan origination definition); handle or file separately. Acceptance: SERVICE_TASK nodes on a PARALLEL_GATEWAY branch are dispatched and recorded; meridian loan-origination scenarios reach committee/L1 routing and complete; regression test fail-first reproducing the stall at engine level. Evidence: test/uat-reports/uat-2026-10-01-WF05-FULL3-20261001-NARRATIVE.yaml (on PR #2129 branch origin/pr2129 only). Q-926 (body_template rendering) is DONE and merged on main -- build on it.

result.summary:
REGISTRY (Step 0.5): ISS-0398 (resolved; walk_to_gateway -> collect_leaf_gateways in transition.ex) is a different defect (blocked instance CREATION with no_matching_join_found); not a recurrence. No resolved entry matches the post-dispatch stall. ISS-0928 itself exists only on origin/pr2129 (not on this branch).

HEADLINE: the filed hypothesis is WRONG. The SERVICE_TASK inside the PARALLEL_GATEWAY fork IS armed and dispatched. The true root cause is not fork-specific and affects top-level SERVICE_TASKs too.

REPRODUCTION (scratch DB-backed ExUnit, run with mix test on that one file, then deleted; git status shows only handoff files). Graph: START -> fork(PARALLEL) -> {h1 HUMAN_TASK, svc SERVICE_TASK} -> join; svc -> xg EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY (kyc_status=='clear' -> join, =='hit' -> HUMAN_TASK, no default edge) -> join; local WebhookTestServer returning {"args":{}} with SSRF bypass.
1. Engine.create: current_nodes ["h1","svc"], tokens [{"h1",:active},{"svc",:active}], service_task_dispatches [{"svc","pending"}]. Fork activation + arming are correct (engine.ex advance_until_stable/4 ~L1489 and tokens_needing_dispatch/3 treat split tokens as fresh; transition.ex dispatch_service_task L750 emits {:service_task_dispatch_requested,..}; create wiring engine.ex L563-577, prepare_service_task_dispatch L900).
2. ServiceTaskDispatcher.attempt_dispatch -> {:ok,{:advance,%{"args"=>%{}}}}; dispatch row status becomes "advanced" (committed in its own txn).
3. Engine.advance_after_service_task_outcome/4 -> {:error,{:transition_failed,{:activation_failed,{:no_matching_edge,"xg",[...]}}}}; its txn rolls back. After: dispatch row "advanced", current_nodes still ["h1","svc"], events ["INSTANCE_STARTED"] only (no SERVICE_TASK_COMPLETED, no EXECUTION_ERROR/INSTANCE_ERROR).
4. Control, TOP-LEVEL (START -> svc -> xg(conditioned only) -> END, no fork): identical -> advance returns :error, current_nodes stays ["svc"]. Bug is independent of PARALLEL_GATEWAY.

ROOT CAUSE: lib/letflow/engine.ex persist_service_task_advance/10 (L3318), error arms L3374-3379: a :no_matching_edge from a downstream EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY comes back as bare {:error,{:transition_failed,..}} instead of being routed into an ExecutionError. The human-task completion path (dispatch_task_completion_hop_chain/7, engine.ex ~L3857 and L3876, req061 sec 5.2) already unwraps {:activation_failed,{:no_matching_edge,..}} / {:no_matching_edge,..} into {:ok,{:execution_error,error_args}} (error_type :no_matching_gateway_edge) which puts the instance into error; the service-task re-entry path never got that treatment. Consequences: (a) advance_after_service_task_outcome/4 (L~3245) rolls back, but the dispatch row was already committed "advanced" by ServiceTaskDispatcher.handle_success (separate commit, documented gap at engine.ex ~L3195-3205), so the poller never re-claims it (terminal); (b) service_task_dispatcher.ex call_advance_after_service_task_outcome L614 folds {:error,reason} silently (uncounted, no log/audit; only :invalid_form_schema gets an audit). Net: token parked forever at the SERVICE_TASK node, instance ACTIVE, no task/event/error/DLQ -- exactly the UAT symptom (the "past 300s timeout_ms" observation is moot: the HTTP call had already succeeded). Same silent-rollback shape applies to any other {:transition_failed|:activation_failed} from this path (hop limit etc.). The timer re-entry path (engine.ex ~L2949/2953) may share the shape; not verified.

WHY TESTS MISSED IT: service_task_wiring_test.exs only covers SERVICE_TASK->END / ->HUMAN_TASK; no test routes a service-task response into an EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY with an unmatched condition, none puts a SERVICE_TASK directly on a fork branch.

FIXTURE ASSESSMENT (secondary, real, separate): test/fixtures/qa/meridian_loan_origination_process_definition.json (graph key): e3 fork->kyc-aml-check, e8 kyc-aml-check->kyc-routing, e9 kyc-routing->assessment-join [kyc_status=='clear'], e10/e11 kyc-routing->kyc-manual-review [hit / inconclusive]; NO default edge. QA endpoint https://httpbin.org/anything/kyc/screen echoes JSON without kyc_status, and neither scenario (test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/meridian/loan-origination-{above,below}-threshold.yaml) supplies kyc_status (grep: no 'kyc' in either). So even after the engine bug is fixed, kyc-routing has no matching edge: the stall becomes a clean EXECUTION_ERROR (instance error), and the two scenarios still cannot complete. Needed fixture change: add is_default to one edge (e.g. an unconditioned default edge kyc-routing -> assessment-join, or make e9 the default), keeping hit/inconclusive -> manual review; ISS-0398's collect_leaf_gateways already supports this branch shape. Respect CHK-13..16 (default edge has no condition, at most one per gateway). The QA-deployed definition (v1.1) must be re-published as a new version.

RECOMMENDED FIX DESIGN (for CODE-DESIGNER): (1) in persist_service_task_advance/10 unwrap {:no_matching_edge,..} and {:activation_failed,{:no_matching_edge,..}} into the execution_error path (reuse dispatch_task_completion_hop_chain's error_args shape / set_instance_error; actor EventStore.platform_actor_id(); idempotency key "service_task_dispatch:<id>") and commit instead of rolling back; (2) make any other post-commit re-entry failure non-silent (at minimum Logger/audit in service_task_dispatcher.ex L614 arm; ideally revert the row for retry or record an ExecutionError); (3) fixture: default edge on kyc-routing (consider kyc_status in stub/scenario input); (4) fail-first regression tests at engine level in test/letflow/engine/service_task_wiring_test.exs (helpers: graph_* builders, enable_ssrf_bypass, WebhookTestServer, ServiceTaskDispatcher.attempt_dispatch + advance_after_service_task_outcome): (a) SERVICE_TASK directly on a PARALLEL_GATEWAY fork branch -> EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY with no match -> instance enters error with no_matching_gateway_edge ExecutionError (currently stays active, silent); (b) same at top level; (c) with a default edge, response lacking kyc_status advances the branch to the join and, once the other branch's human task completes, the join fires and the instance reaches the next node.

FILES TO CHANGE: lib/letflow/engine.ex (persist_service_task_advance/10 ~L3318-3380, possibly do_persist_service_task_advance L3385+); lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex (L614 arm); test/fixtures/qa/meridian_loan_origination_process_definition.json; test/letflow/engine/service_task_wiring_test.exs; docs/issues/ISS-0928.yaml (reframe) and docs/anti-patterns.md (entry: committed-terminal row + rolled-back re-entry = silent stall).

SECURITY-REVIEWER: likely not mandatory (engine-internal error routing, no API route/migration/secrets/response shaping). Required if the design adds new audit/event writes crossing tenant-schema prefix handling. REVIEWER and CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR apply.

SCOPE NOTE: the issue acceptance "SERVICE_TASK nodes on a PARALLEL_GATEWAY branch are dispatched and recorded" already holds (reproduced); ORCH should reframe ISS-0928 title/description to the real cause.
issues: Filed hypothesis (fork-branch SERVICE_TASK never dispatched) disproved: dispatch is armed and executed; real cause is silent rollback of advance_after_service_task_outcome on no_matching_edge, not fork-specific.
QA fixture kyc-routing lacks a default edge and the stub returns no kyc_status.
Timer re-entry path (engine.ex ~L2949) may share the silent-failure shape; unverified.

Then CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR -> ELIXIR-DEV.
